summary: Het canh NAS chay 100% CPU moi lan khoi dong: video da tao proxy xong khong con bi transcode lai tu dau.
changes: Sua loi SQLite gan sai tham so cho cac cau lenh co $1, $3, $2 khong theo thu tu: job transcode da xong van bi ghi la 'dang chay', nen moi lan worker khoi dong (khoi dong lai NAS, lich bat/tat nguon) Coopeditor tao lai proxy cho ca thu vien bang CPU.
Lan khoi dong dau tien sau khi cap nhat, worker tu dong dong cac job da xong nhung con ket, khong transcode lai them lan nao.
Cung loi do cung da sua: job loi gio duoc thu lai dung lich (5 giay, 25 giay, ...) thay vi ket; doi vai tro thanh vien du an va cap nhat ten/email tai khoan DSM/OIDC gio luu dung.
